summary: A picker that lists recent personal events (photos, places, workouts and similar) to inspire a journal entry. BifrOSt has a Journal app but no suggestions picker, no suggestion asset model and no suggestion notifications. iPadOS 26.0 and later per the index.

No entitlement model for the picker.

gaps: No suggestions picker, suggestion model or suggestion notifications.
